hypotheses.explanation: Charge takes 103.7 ms client-side but only 0.515 ms server-side, with roughly 101 ms before server processing begins. This supports communication-path delay contributing to checkout latency.

Several currency RPCs take 72–83 ms client-side while corresponding server processing stays below 0.5 ms. Repeated gaps support communication-path latency, although client scheduling delay cannot be excluded.

Frontend server spans report ERROR across multiple routes despite successful downstream RPCs, suggesting frontend-local application failure. Confidence is limited because request metrics report success and logs contain no explicit exception.
